description:
The 4StoreyBuilding model is loaded in eQUEST. An architect has proposed adding a central atrium skylight to the top floor to improve daylighting. Your task is to create a new skylight on the roof of the Top Floor Core zone (T.C35). 

Navigate to the Building Shell module, locate zone 'T.C35', and find its Roof surface (Exterior Wall with Tilt = 0). Create a new Window object on this roof with the following properties:
- Height: 20 ft
- Width: 20 ft
- X-offset: 15 ft
- Y-offset: 15 ft
- Glass Type: Select the standard double clear glass (e.g., 'Gt 1 (Dbl Clr Air)')

After creating the skylight, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to update the results, then save the project.
